BOBBY WORKBOOK TASK 4 (Sept 30). Goal: finish the quote in Kevin's email and get written evidence the correct employer's policy is active. California requires workers' comp even with one employee.

Steps: (1) Search Kevin's email for 'workers comp', 'quote', 'broker', 'insurance'; note broker, insurer, quote expiry, outstanding requirements. (2) Verify legal name (KMD Group LLC dba KMD Analytical), EIN from the IRS letter, worksite address, payroll, employee count, duties, effective date. (3) Use AI to organize the quote; redact personal identifiers; never guess payroll, class codes, claims or exclusions. (4) Follow up in the existing broker thread; supply EIN securely; request final premium, deposit, exclusions, employer liability limits, earliest effective date. (5) Bind and pay through the authorized process; route signatures/spending authority to Kevin; never backdate or call a quote a policy. (6) Obtain binder/policy, effective date and time, payment confirmation, proof of coverage, employee notices, claim-reporting instructions.
Done when: policy confirmed active in writing and evidence saved with KMD's insurance records.

STATUS (Oct 7): Pie Insurance (Samantha Sanchez) sent the estimated-premium summary: $215,800 payroll, $2,542/yr, $204/mo, $676 deposit; pay-as-you-go available. Adrian: pay in full if you can. Remaining: confirm effective date, bind, save proof. Quote PDF is in the Files tab.
